title: selliguea metacoela
intro: Selliguea metacoela, commonly known as the Polynesian shield fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea metacoela are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are known to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic effects and potential uses.
